description: issue #837 (maintainer ruling #833), reversing issue #739: the profile-INACTIVE half of the binding pair. The same three variable bindings check clean under `core-language` alone, and — since the ruling — they check clean with `sprites` active too (reserved-bindings-with-sprites). Binding a built-in name is free in every position and under every profile set: spec/grammar.md:386 makes it a normative MUST, and spec/grammar.md:388 explains why enforcement sits at the four declaration slots instead. The pair used to prove that the binding rule was profile-gated; it now proves that binding freedom is profile-independent, which is the stronger statement. This is a `"check": true` fixture: it asserts the absence of the checker diagnostic, not execution — nothing is drawn and no events are produced.
